name: tail
summary: Output the last part of files.
description: Print the last 10 lines of each FILE to standard output. With more than one file, precede each with a header.

options.description: Output the last NUM lines, instead of last 10.
Output appended data as the file grows (follow mode).

examples.title: Follow log file in real time
examples.output:
[2026-10-12 10:00:00] Server started on port 5000
[2026-10-12 10:01:23] GET /api/health 200 OK
examples.explanation: Continuously streams new lines appended to app.log.

useCases: Monitoring active server logs in real time
